note: Hand-authored dataset metadata. tools/build_app.py adds sha256 and row counts and writes data/MANIFEST.json. Bump a dataset's version when its content changes.

datasets.origin: S01 NASA/TP-2015-216046 Table IX, printed pp. 20–28 (PDF 26–34)
datasets.method: tools/extract_table_ix.py — pdftotext -layout, cells verbatim (*_raw) + parsed
processing_history: M2: every cell checked by a second parser and against 300-dpi page images (data/verification)
datasets.limitations: Reproduces the printed table; printed errors are not corrected (see discrepancy register).

datasets.origin: S01 NASA/TP-2015-216046 Tables I–VIII, printed pp. 10–15 (PDF 16–21)
datasets.method: tools/extract_test_matrix.py — pdftotext -layout; header constants copied with origin='table header'
processing_history: M2: extracted; all 153 rows checked by a second parser (data/verification/test_matrix_verification.json)
M3: every cell checked against 300-dpi page images (1432 cells; 25 disagreements reviewed visually, all match)
datasets.limitations: Nominal/planned conditions; covers 153 tests (DSC-022).

datasets.origin: S01 NASA/TP-2015-216046 Appendix B captions, Figs. 5–280
datasets.method: tools/extract_appendix_b_index.py — caption text verbatim
datasets.limitations: Index and captions only; plot data not extracted.

datasets.origin: DS-TP-APPB-INDEX
datasets.method: tools/crosscheck_tables.py — regex 'fiber[- ]supported' / 'free[- ]floating' on verbatim captions
datasets.limitations: Keyword classification of NASA text, not a measurement.

datasets.origin: DS-TP-TABLE-IX, DS-TP-TEST-MATRIX, DS-DERIVED-FIBER-CAPTIONS
datasets.method: tools/crosscheck_tables.py — agreement within printed rounding
datasets.limitations: 'DIFFERS' states a fact about printed values; it does not say which value is right.

datasets.origin: DS-TP-TABLE-IX vs PDF text layer (pdfplumber) and rendered page images (Tesseract + connected components)

processing_history: M2: created; 80 image disagreements reviewed visually (table_ix_manual_review.json)
datasets.limitations: Checks extraction fidelity only, not the correctness of NASA's values.

datasets.origin: Visual review of crops listed in DS-VERIFY-TABLE-IX

datasets.limitations: Reviewer is the AI assistant, not an independent human.
